message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts: Chen rented a supermarket space, opened a clothing processing factory, employed workers, owed wages 85,361 RMB to 15 workers, escaped, refused to pay. Labor bureau ordered to pay by June 27, still not paid. Later paid 51,000 RMB, remaining owed with IOU.

Thus the crime is refusing to pay labor remuneration (refusing to pay wages). The label in list: "拒不支付劳动报酬". Indeed earlier examples used that label for similar facts. So answer is single charge: 拒不支付劳动报酬.
